question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

Recent party plenums and personnel actions, including extensive military leadership changes in 2025–2026, have reinforced centralized authority and ideological alignment without evident factional opposition. Leadership transitions in the CCP typically occur at national congresses, with the next scheduled for 2027, where expectations center on continuity rather than abrupt change. Xi, at age 73, continues public engagement on economic planning and foreign policy without reported health constraints. While elite politics remain opaque, low-probability disruptions such as a sudden medical event or severe internal crisis could still shift dynamics before the resolution window closes.
